turns.source: Hi, I bought the X200 headphones from your store last week.
They stopped charging yesterday.

phenomena.expected: 指 X200 耳机，应译为“耳机”或省略主语但语义指耳机，不能译成“他们”
指给耳机充电，应译为“充电”，不能译成“收费”

turns.source: I already tried a different cable, but it didn't help.

phenomena.expected: 指“换数据线”这件事，应译为“没用/没有效果”之类，不能指耳机

turns.source: Can I get a replacement, or do I need to send them back first?

phenomena.expected: 指耳机，应译为“耳机”或“它们（耳机）”，不能译成“他们”

turns.source: Also, the case has a small crack.

phenomena.expected: 指耳机的充电盒/收纳盒，应译为“充电盒/耳机盒”，不能译成“案件/箱子”

turns.source: I'm writing on behalf of my mother, Linda Chen.
She placed an order two days ago but hasn't received a confirmation email.

phenomena.expected: 指母亲 Linda，应译为“她”或“我母亲”

turns.source: Could you resend it to her new address?

phenomena.expected: 指确认邮件，应译为“确认邮件”或语义上指邮件
指母亲，应译为“她的”

turns.source: The old one has been closed for months.

phenomena.expected: 指旧的邮箱地址，应译为“旧邮箱/旧地址”

turns.source: Please address her as Mrs. Chen in the reply.

phenomena.expected: 应译为“陈女士”或“陈太太”，与前文 Linda Chen 一致

turns.source: I returned the blue jacket on Monday.
When will I get my money back?
The tracking page says you received it on Wednesday.

phenomena.expected: 指退回的蓝色夹克/退货包裹，不能指钱

turns.source: The black one I kept fits perfectly, by the way.

phenomena.expected: 指黑色夹克，应译为“黑色那件（夹克）”

turns.source: Could you refund it to my original card instead of store credit?

phenomena.expected: 指退款金额/这笔钱，应译为“退款/这笔钱”，不能指夹克

turns.source: Our technician, David, will visit your home on Friday.
He will call you about thirty minutes before arriving.

phenomena.expected: 指技术员 David，应译为“他”或“技术员”

turns.source: If the time doesn't work for you, just let him know.

phenomena.expected: 指 David，应译为“他”

turns.source: Please make sure someone over 18 is present.
David will bring the spare parts, so you don't need to buy anything.

phenomena.expected: 人名应与前文译法一致（如都保留 David 或都译为“大卫”）

turns.source: Your Pro plan will renew automatically on June 1.
The charge will appear as TLX*PRO on your statement.

phenomena.expected: 指扣费/费用，应译为“扣款/费用”，不能译成“充电”

turns.source: If you'd like to cancel, you can do it in Settings.

phenomena.expected: 指取消订阅这件事

turns.source: You'll keep access until the end of the current period.
We can also switch you to the Basic plan, which costs half as much.

phenomena.expected: 指价格是 Pro 套餐的一半，应体现“比 Pro 套餐便宜一半/价格为一半”

turns.source: Good evening, Ms. Rivera. Welcome to the Harbor Hotel.
Your room is on the eighth floor, facing the sea.

phenomena.expected: 对客人应使用敬称“您”，与上一轮称谓语气一致

turns.source: Breakfast is served in the lobby restaurant until ten.
Would you like us to book a table there for dinner as well?

phenomena.expected: 指大堂餐厅，应译为“在大堂餐厅/在那里（餐厅）”
应使用“您”

turns.source: Ms. Rivera, your luggage will be brought up shortly.

phenomena.expected: 称谓与第一轮一致（如“里维拉女士”或保留 Ms. Rivera）

turns.source: We noticed a login to your account from a new device.
If it was you, no action is needed.

phenomena.expected: 指这次登录，应译为“这次登录是您本人操作”之类

turns.source: If not, please reset your password right away.

phenomena.expected: 指“如果不是您本人登录”，应体现完整含义

turns.source: You can also review all active sessions on the security page.
Sign out of the ones you don't recognize.

phenomena.expected: 指不认识的登录会话/设备，应译为“不认识的会话/设备”

turns.source: My colleagues and I ordered twelve lunch boxes for the team meeting.
They arrived on time, but three were missing the sauce.

phenomena.expected: 指午餐盒，应译为“餐盒/盒饭”，不能译成“他们（同事）”
指其中三份餐盒

turns.source: Two of my colleagues are vegetarian, and theirs were fine.

phenomena.expected: 指那两位素食同事的餐盒

turns.source: Could you send the sauce separately, or refund those three?

phenomena.expected: 指缺酱料的三份餐盒

turns.source: We'll order from you again next week if it's sorted out.

phenomena.expected: 指这次缺酱料的问题

turns.source: I adopted a kitten named Momo last month.
She refuses to eat the dry food I bought from you.

phenomena.expected: 指小猫 Momo，应译为“它/她（Momo）”，不能译成“他”

turns.source: Do you have a smaller size so I can try a different flavor?

phenomena.expected: 指猫粮的小包装

turns.source: The vet said she should gain a little weight.

phenomena.expected: 指小猫 Momo

turns.source: Momo does like the salmon treats, though.

phenomena.expected: 名字与第一轮译法一致

turns.source: Your flight to Osaka has been delayed by four hours.
You can rebook it free of charge until midnight.

phenomena.expected: 指飞往大阪的航班，应译为“该航班”或语义上指航班

turns.source: The 6:40 one tomorrow still has seats.

phenomena.expected: 指明天 6:40 的航班，应译为“明天 6:40 的航班”

turns.source: If you take it, we'll cover one night at the airport hotel.

phenomena.expected: 指明天 6:40 的那趟航班

turns.source: Your bags will be transferred automatically.

phenomena.expected: 指行李自动转到改签后的航班，应译为“转运/转到新航班”，不能译成“转账”

turns.source: The sofa and the two armchairs will be delivered on Saturday morning.
The driver will need help carrying the larger one upstairs.

phenomena.expected: 指沙发（最大的那件），应译为“沙发/较大的那件（沙发）”

turns.source: The chairs can go in the elevator.

phenomena.expected: 指前文的两把扶手椅，应与“扶手椅”译法一致

turns.source: Please measure the doorway before then.

phenomena.expected: 指周六送货之前

turns.source: If it's narrower than 80 cm, we can remove the legs.

phenomena.expected: 指门口/门框的宽度
指沙发的腿（沙发脚）

turns.source: My son, Leo, is interested in your summer coding camp.
He is eleven and has used Scratch before.

phenomena.expected: 指儿子 Leo，应译为“他”

turns.source: Is the beginner class too easy for him?

phenomena.expected: 指 Leo，应译为“他”

turns.source: His older sister took the advanced one last year and loved it.

phenomena.expected: 指高级班
指 Leo 的姐姐，应译为“他的姐姐”

turns.source: Could Leo join the same class as his friend?

phenomena.expected: 名字与前文译法一致
